description_target.target_text: Marker gravity: the struct color is the least-common color of the BOTTOM ROW; the marker color is the least-common color overall (excluding struct); the remaining color is the background. Every marker object falls as a rigid unit until its cells would enter a row that is struct (or sits directly above struct), or collide with another marker object. racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
  ;; Marker gravity: the struct color is the least-common color of the BOTTOM
  ;; ROW; the marker color is the least-common color overall (excluding
  ;; struct); the remaining color is the background. Every marker object falls
  ;; as a rigid unit until its cells would enter a row that is struct (or sits
  ;; directly above struct), or collide with another marker object. Objects
  ;; relax one step at a time, in order, until nothing moves.
  (lambda (g)
    (let* ((h (rows g))
           (counts (color-frequency g))
           (struct-c (pick-min (unique (row g (- h 1)))
                               (lambda (v) (hash-ref counts v))))
           (rest1 (filter (lambda (v) (!= v struct-c)) (grid-colors g)))
           (mcolor (pick-min rest1 (lambda (v) (hash-ref counts v))))
           (bg (first (filter (lambda (v) (!= v mcolor)) rest1)))
           (struct? (lambda (r c) (and (< r h) (= (at g r c) struct-c))))
           (blocked? (lambda (r c) (or (>= (+ r 1) h) (struct? r c) (struct? (+ r 1) c))))
           (marker-mask (cellmap g (r c v) (if (= v mcolor) mcolor bg)))
           (objs (map obj-cells (objects marker-mask bg)))
           (settled
             (let relax ((groups objs))
               (let ((next
                       (let step ((idx 0) (cur groups))
                         (if (>= idx (length cur))
                             cur
                             (let* ((o (list-ref cur idx))
                                    (others (flatmap (lambda (i)
                                                       (if (= i idx) (list) (list-ref cur i)))
                                                     (range 0 (length cur))))
                                    (movable
                                      (all? (lambda (p)
                                              (let ((nr (+ (first p) 1)) (nc (second p)))
                                                (and (< nr h)
                                                     (not (blocked? nr nc))
                                                     (not (member (list nr nc) others)))))
                                            o))
                                    (o2 (if movable
                                            (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first p) 1) (second p))) o)
                                            o)))
                               (step (+ idx 1) (list-set cur idx o2)))))))
                 (if (equal? next groups) groups (relax next))))))
      (recolor-cells (cellmap g (r c v) (if (= v mcolor) bg v))
                     (flatmap (lambda (o) o) settled)
                     mcolor))))
